name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with a partner holding your ankles or feet hooked under something sturdy.
Keeping a straight line from knees to head, lean back as far as you can control.
Use the quads to brake the descent — don't just fall.
Pull yourself back up. An intense bodyweight quad builder.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Reverse Nordic Curl is an advanced core exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
